Why teams switch

  • Your morning briefing used to take an hour of tabs — now it is one screen.
  • The weather for every office shows up on its own — no setup, no plugins.
  • Headlines refresh while the room is still talking about them — not after.
  • Every quote is picked by a person on the team — never by an algorithm.
  • Market movers land at the open and again at the close — twice is enough.
  • Flights for the airports you use most are always in view — and on time.
  • Sports scores follow the leagues your team actually watches — all of them.
  • The café menu updates itself when the specials change — every single day.
